quotes.text: Don't stop when you're tired. Stop when you're done.
The most important conversations you'll ever have are the ones you have with yourself.
You have power over your mind — not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.
The impediment to action advances action. What stands in the way becomes the way.
Your time is limited, so don't waste it living someone else's life.
Stay hungry. Stay foolish.
The longer you're willing to delay gratification, the more successful you become.
You are only one skill away from a completely different life.
If you're lucky enough to be different, never change.
You are the only one who gets to decide what you will be remembered for.
I'd rather bet on myself and lose than never bet on myself at all.
The second you stop apologizing for who you are, everything changes.
Power is not given to you. You have to take it.
If everything was perfect, you would never learn and you would never grow.
Anything is possible if you have the right people there to support you.
Just because it takes you longer doesn't mean you failed.
Turn your wounds into wisdom.
The biggest adventure you can take is to live the life of your dreams.
You are one decision away from a completely different life.
If you have an impulse to act on a goal, move within five seconds — or your brain will stop you.
Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find.
With God all things are possible.
God didn't bring you this far to leave you.
The waiting season is not wasted — it's the preparation.
Hard work beats talent when talent doesn't work hard.
Do it right the first time so you don't have to do it twice.
